Mali.title: Tenenkou: 14 tons of food will be distributed to 231 vulnerable households
Mali.summary: Tenenkou, 10 October (AMAP) A total of 14 tonnes of millet will be distributed to 231 vulnerable households, or 1,389 beneficiaries in the urban commune of Tenenkou, as part of the national food insecurity response plan. The launch ceremony of this operation was held Saturday in front of the town hall, under the chairmanship of the 2nd deputy to the prefect, the Chief Commissioner of Police Ousmane Diamouténé, noted AMAP .

Mali.title: Mali.. Army targets two vehicles in Kidal and Timbuktu base
Mali.summary: The Malian Army announced the targeting of two vehicles that it said were transporting "armed elements" southwest of Kidal city, in addition to carrying out an airstrike that targeted a base that includes armed elements and military and logistical equipment in the Ndaki area in Timbuktu state. He said in a statement issued on Friday evening that the two vehicles were spotted 45 and 46 kilometers southwest of Kidal during the ongoing military operations in the eastern region.

Mali.title: GOONGA TAN: Kidal: the return of the flag, the return
Mali.summary: Mali finds Kidal. But beyond a military victory, it is a political, historical and symbolic battle that changes its nature. Indeed, this Tuesday, October 6, 2026 will undoubtedly remain as one of the highlights of Mali's recent history .

Mali.title: Mali: The national flag now flies in the sky of Kidal
Mali.summary: Kidal, the strategic city in northern Mali has been back in the fold of the state since Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The Malian Armed Forces (Fama) and their Russian allies have indeed managed to take control of this megalopolis after a major military offensive . To mark the total and entire membership of the Ifoghas city in the Republic of Mali, the national flag was raised on its public buildings.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike hard in Kidal and Timbuktu
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strikes hard in Kidal and Timbuktu Two surgical strikes conducted by FAMa, with the support of their partners, neutralized terrorist elements in the Eastern and Central regions as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Eastern Theater: This Friday, October 9, 2026, two vehicles carrying terrorists were spotted 45 and 46 km southwest of Kidal .

Mali.title: 7 Mali: The takeover of Kidal "consolidates" the Transition
Mali.summary: In Mali, the army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps reinvested Tuesday, October 6, the city of Kidal, in the north of the country, less than six months after being driven out by the separatists of the Fla and their jihadist allies of the Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. This prestigious victory was achieved without even having to fight, as the armed groups withdrew before the arrival of the army .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: suspension of flour exports
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has suspended until further notice the export of millet, maize and sorghum flour, as well as their derivatives, to ensure their availability on the national market, according to an official statement consulted on Saturday . A measure to freeze exports of millet, maize and sorghum flour was announced by the Burkinabe authorities in a press release dated 9 October and signed by the Minister of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts, Serge Gnaniodem Poda.

Niger.title: Traditional chieftaincy: Mr. Bachir Sadou Kalilou elected 16th chief of canton of Sakoira
Niger.summary: Tillabéri, 10 Oct (ANP) – Mr. Bachir Sadou Kalilou, was elected this Saturday, October 10, 2026, unanimously by his peers, 16th head of canton of Sakoira, a rural commune attached to the department of Tillabéri .

Niger.title: "Epic of Niger", a project by cultural entrepreneur Ibrahima Abdoul-Rachid: "It is enough for a people to turn to their memory for the future to change"
Niger.summary: Through the ecological company A.S.I.D., founded in 2020 and continuously active, Mr. Soumaila Ibrahima Abdoul-Rachid, cultural entrepreneur, proposes innovative and multisectoral initiatives combining ecology, digital and culture . This includes waste recovery such as the transformation of used tyres into urban and school furniture, edutainment projects, as well as the production of major cultural and transmedia works that strengthen the memory and intellectual sovereignty of the Nigerien public.
